# Purpose (user ruling U1, ERRATA_6 E6-1): the R4 plancall twice rows for NTH 12-16 were run WITHOUT S4FMM_TWICE (R5 E5-10).
# This pre-registration re-runs them as a NEW R6 run with S4FMM_TWICE=slab.  The R4 results are NOT overwritten.
# Each point runs twice (pass 1 and pass 2).  Route: twice.  S4FMM_TWICE=slab is set by the R6 runner for every row.
# Injection request: plancall:K:1 (the R4 injector inject_r4_plan.cpp, M = 1 = the first wrapped malloc of plan call K).
# inj_call (fixed by the measured plan split, not guessed):  gdb R6-1 plan-split count (r6_plan_split.gdb, read-only, no
#   injection, S4FMM_TWICE=slab, tree F for fft and kottke and tree B for kottke):  11 plan calls happen in the FIRST
#   GetFieldPlane call, and 11 more (plan calls 12..22) in the SECOND.  So K <= 11 is injected on call 1; K >= 12 on call 2.
#   (the first attempt, with the arguments in the wrong order, returned RC -4 and counted 0 plan calls; it is not used.)
#   F = REPORTED_FAILURE  (basis: R5-2 Q1-Q3, the K=12 fft point under S4FMM_TWICE=slab: plan 12 returns NULL, the NULL check at
#                          fmm_FFT.cpp:90 is executed (FFT_NULLCHK_L90 k=6), FMMGetEpsilon_FFT returns 1, ComputeLayerModes returns 20,
#                          GetFieldPlane returns 20; and R5-3 M=2 36 points, all F REPORTED_FAILURE)
#   B = CRASH             (basis: R5-2 Q2, the K=12 fft point under S4FMM_TWICE=slab on B: no NULL check after plan 12, then
#                          fft_plan_exec(NULL) and SIGSEGV at fft_iface.cpp:131; and R5-3 M=2 36 points, all B CRASH)
# Status: INFLUENCED (the basis is the R5 observation of the same kind of point; the R5 observation is not blind to these points).
# Expected-class rule (fixed here): the R6 result is judged by judge_d003.classify on facts (rc, rc1, rc2, hit) with the inj_call
# column.  The driver PASS/FAIL line is not read.  The K=3 control expectation is the R4 expectation (B CRASH, F REPORTED_FAILURE),
# which for the twice route also holds with inj_call 1 (the R4 K=3 twice rows: B CRASH, F REPORTED_FAILURE, hit 1).
